program.name: Boxer's Engine
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Boxing bouts for skill, then Tabata intervals for the engine a fighter needs, then abs.
program.about: Boxing bouts for skill, then Tabata intervals for the engine. Three or four 3-minute bouts mix basics, movement and power, and a Tabata of cardio and core follows: 20 seconds hard, 10 seconds rest. Abs finish every session. Levels II and III bring longer combinations and harder cardio moves. For fitness first, with boxing as the way in.
